pages.title: Enchanting Reworked
pages.text: Enchanting has been reworked into a $(thing)skill-tree$(). $(br2)Unlock branches with $(item)books$() found while exploring, no more villager trading or table lottery.

pages.title: Building Bookshelves
pages.text: $(item)Chiseled bookshelves$() should be built around the table. $(br2)Slot in an $(item)enchanted book$() to unlock its branch on the Enchanting Table.

pages.title: Cost
pages.text: Each tier costs $(thing)XP levels$() & $(item)lapis$(). $(br2)$(bold)You must unlock each tier in order$(), no skipping to high levels.

pages.title: Repairing
pages.text: $(item)Anvil$() XP costs are much lower for $(item)enchanted gear$().
